prompt: A panoramic scene shows a laboratory releasing a transparent crate of glowing numerical matrices that people download onto their own laptops and servers to inspect, run and fine-tune locally, while a sealed corporate cloud on one side accepts only remote prompts and never reveals its hidden model; the crate sits as an ice-frozen public snapshot that later padlocks cannot fully retract, a towering data-centre rack dwarfs a struggling personal computer to show the hardware barrier, and unused stacks of training data and source-code volumes remain in shadow to mark the gap from full open source.
